items.note: "It's just for me, so there are no accounts, login..."
"I want a personal habit tracker running on my machine today" and "This is an MVP... don't write tests."
Vite + React app run locally with the dev server and opened in the browser.
"Data stays in the browser's localStorage", with no server.
"Add, edit and delete habits" means it tracks multiple habits.
"Check off a habit for today (and un-check it)."
"Show a simple 30-day history per habit: the last 30 days, each marked done or not done."
